gemini.performance_metric: Net income attributable to common stockholders was $402,660,000 for the year ended December 31, 2021
gemini.rationale: The slice documents a strategic shift to divest the data center segment and focus on healthcare properties, but does not document any operational disruption or incoherence at the product/process interface (p4_pathway = 0). Additionally, while the company internalized its management, there is no evidence of fracture between operations and the organization or culture (p5_pathway = 0).

grok.performance_metric: divested all 29 data centers for $1.32bn (~$396M gain)
grok.rationale: The slice documents a 2021 board-driven sale of the entire data center segment as a 'strategic shift' completed at a ~$396M gain, with no evidence that data-center assets could not be aligned with operating processes over time, so p4_pathway is 0. Internalization in 2020 moved Former Advisor personnel onto the registrant's payroll (63 employees by year-end 2021) with only a ~$671k goodwill write-off and no documented operations-vs-organization fracture, so p5_pathway is 0.

openai.performance_metric: sold all 29 data center properties for $1.32bn, realizing a $395.8m gain
openai.rationale: The FY2021 Form 10-K documents the complete sale of the data center segment as a strategic shift, but does not attribute the divestiture to failure to align that segment with operating processes [SRC: SEC accession 0001567925-22-000015]. It also documents the successful internalization of management functions and transfer of former Advisor personnel to direct employment, with no stated operations-versus-organization fracture [SRC: SEC accession 0001567925-22-000015].
